conditions.qwen_plain: Same system prompt and decoding; user message is only the original sentence. Removes analysis, morphology, references and structured-user instructions together.
conditions.full_repeat: Exactly repeat the saved v2_graph request to observe run-to-run variability.
conditions.compact_references: Same request except evidence quote bodies, condition-check logs and per-reference status removed. Claims/conditions/scope/notes/bindings/paths retained. Evidence text loss is a confound, not a lossless serialization claim.
conditions.without_meonjeo_mapping: Same request except exactly one 먼저->앞에 statement and any incident paths removed.

selection: 7 diagnostic failure cases chosen after observing development outputs; 3 mapping-removal cases among them.
limitations: One new sample per condition; same seed is not a determinism guarantee.
Prompt and batch conventions differ across models; Sonnet version/settings/prompt not supplied.
No independent native-speaker quality labels or causal significance test.
